name: Crop
description: Cuts a rectangle out of the picture; the output has the size of the rectangle.

params.name: w
params.description: Width of the rectangle in pixels; 0 = the input's width (`out_w`)

params.name: h
params.description: Height of the rectangle in pixels; 0 = the input's height (`out_h`)

params.name: x
params.description: Left edge of the rectangle; -1 = centred

params.name: y
params.description: Top edge of the rectangle; -1 = centred
